title: Balanced writing frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Local area, holiday and travel: town, region and country; holidays (2.3, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 38 (Balanced writing frame (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 38: My town: good points and problems; a balanced view. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Suggesting solutions
points: عَلَى البَلَدِيَّةِ أَنْ تَبْنِيَ مَرَاكِزَ لِلشَّبَابِ
مِنَ المُهِمِّ أَنْ نُحَافِظَ عَلَى نَظَافَةِ الشَّوَارِعِ

parts.text: مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ، مَدِينَتِي حَيَوِيَّةٌ وَالمَوَاصَلَاتُ فِيهَا جَيِّدَةٌ.
وَمِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى، هُنَاكَ اِزْدِحَامٌ وَتَلَوُّثٌ فِي وَسَطِ المَدِينَةِ.
فِي رَأْيِي، يَجِبُ عَلَى البَلَدِيَّةِ أَنْ تَزْرَعَ أَشْجَارًا أَكْثَرَ.
بِالرَّغْمِ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ، أُحِبُّ مَدِينَتِي لِأَنَّ أُسْرَتِي هُنَا.

parts.label: Start
parts.text: يَجِبُ أَنْ. Verb in the subjunctive: نَمْشِيَ (fathah). Alternative: بَدَلًا مِنَ السَّيَّارَاتِ.

questions.q: Write a solution to traffic congestion with يَجِبُ أَنْ.
questions.a: For example: يَجِبُ أَنْ نَمْشِيَ أَوْ نَرْكَبَ الدَّرَّاجَاتِ بَدَلًا مِنَ السَّيَّارَاتِ.

questions.q: Translate: Despite the noise, I like my town.
Core: Write 100 to 120 words (portal response box): مَدِينَتِي: إِيجَابِيَّاتٌ وَسَلْبِيَّاتٌ. Include two positives, two problems, a solution and a conclusion.
questions.a: Marked as a Paper 4 / Paper 2 style task: content, range (balancing phrases, subjunctive), accuracy.

questions.q: Extend (Group A, 4AA1 summary skill): read the model paragraph and summarise it in 25 Arabic words in your own words.
questions.a: For example: يَرَى الكَاتِبُ أَنَّ مَدِينَتَهُ حَيَوِيَّةٌ لٰكِنَّ فِيهَا اِزْدِحَامًا وَتَلَوُّثًا، وَيَقْتَرِحُ زِرَاعَةَ الأَشْجَارِ، وَيُحِبُّهَا لِأَنَّ أُسْرَتَهُ هُنَاكَ.

questions.q: Stretch: Add a sentence in the future about how your town will be in ten years.
questions.a: For example: بَعْدَ عَشْرِ سَنَوَاتٍ سَتَكُونُ مَدِينَتِي أَنْظَفَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللّٰهُ.
A) مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى. مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ أُخْرَى = on the other hand.

questions.q: What is تَلَوُّث? A) pollution B) congestion C) noise
Big question: what makes an argument balanced?
questions.a: Both positives and negatives, linked with balancing phrases, then a reasoned conclusion or solution.
